description: Follow up a US 10DLC or toll-free texting registration on the brand's own Twilio or Telnyx account. action otp_status (Telnyx: the sole-proprietor code's delivery) | resend_otp (text the sole-proprietor owner a new code; Telnyx pinSms must contain @OTP_PIN@) | verify_otp (Telnyx: otpPin the owner received; on Twilio the owner replies to Twilio's text instead) | appeal (a rejected campaign: Telnyx files appealReason for a TELNYX_FAILED or MNO_REJECTED campaign; Twilio has no appeal form and resubmits the campaign with its fixes) | update_campaign (Twilio: description, messageFlow, samples, hasLinks, hasPhone, privacyPolicyUrl, termsUrl, resubmitted for review; Telnyx: samples, messageFlow, helpMessage only) | resubmit_brand (Twilio resubmit; Telnyx revet, once after registration then every three months) | brand_feedback (Telnyx: what the vetting flagged, by field) | edit_tollfree (verificationId: answer the reviewer's change request with the changed fields and editReason). smsBrandId, campaignId and (Twilio) messagingServiceSid come from sms_registration_status. optInProof: screenshots of the opt-in form (Library ids, attachment://N or https links), added to the campaign's message flow or the toll-free request. Every filing changes nothing without confirm:true; show the user the dry run first. The provider may bill its vetting fees; free in Hermoso. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).

editReason.description: Twilio: what changed, for the reviewer

optInProof.description: Library ids, attachment://N or https links to opt-in form screenshots
